lead.titleZh: 多项RCT提示物理治疗新方向
lead.titleEn: Multiple RCTs Point to New Directions in Physical Therapy
lead.paragraphZh: 今日数据涵盖15条信息，聚焦骨科与肌骨、神经康复等领域。其中，两条评分85分的RCT研究在慢性卒中手功能恢复及非特异性腰痛的辅助治疗方面提供了值得关注的信号。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's data comprises 15 items across specialties including musculoskeletal and neurological rehabilitation. Two RCTs, both scoring 85, offer notable signals regarding functional hand recovery in chronic stroke and adjunct therapies for chronic non-specific low back pain.

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) combined with conventional physical therapy led to significantly greater improvements in upper-limb motor function (ARAT scores increased by 12.05 and 12.44 points respectively, P < .001) compared to conventional physical therapy alone in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者的手功能恢复，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电图引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 都比单纯常规物理治疗效果更好，但两者之间没有显著差异。在设计手功能康复方案时，不必纠结于这两种电刺激技术的选择，可优先考虑患者依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中手功能恢复疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，结合常规物理治疗的感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）均能显著改善上肢运动功能（ARAT 评分分别增加 12.05 和 12.44 分，P < .001），效果优于单独的常规物理治疗，但 SES 与 Alt-EMG 之间没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hand function recovery in chronic stroke patients, both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) are superior to conventional physical therapy alone, but there is no significant difference between the two. When designing hand rehabilitation programs, focus on patient adherence and equipment availability rather than overthinking the choice between these two electrical stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 60 人，随访期为 12 周，可能限制了长期效应和在不同卒中阶段的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 60 participants with a 12-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and applicability across different stroke stages.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=148) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4) or disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9) compared with sham PBMT in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain over 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型 RCT 明确表明，对于慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）并无额外临床益处。下次评估腰痛方案时，请将 PBMT 从常规选项中排除。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练的辅助手段，对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的疗效微乎其微：一项随机试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=148）发现，对于慢性非特异性腰痛成人，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）与假 PBMT 相比，在 12 个月内对疼痛强度（MD -0.4 分, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4）或残疾（MD -0.7 分, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9）没有临床上重要的额外改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large RCT clearly shows that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise offers no additional clinical benefit for chronic non-specific low back pain. Exclude PBMT from routine options when evaluating back pain protocols.
items.limitation: 研究排除了有特定病理或脊柱手术史的患者，结果主要适用于慢性非特异性腰痛人群。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded patients with specific pathologies or previous spinal surgery, so results primarily apply to individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and depressive symptoms compared to usual care in this RCT.
items.curatedReason: 6个月的线上康复训练（Pilates+筋膜放松）显著改善了纤维肌痛患者的症状和睡眠，别再依赖线下常规治疗了。
items.titleZh: 结合普拉提治疗性锻炼和自我筋膜松解术的六个月监督远程康复治疗对纤维肌痛症患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六个月的监督性远程康复项目，结合了普拉提为基础的锻炼和自我筋膜松解术，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的影响、睡眠质量和心理结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care.
items.limitation: 未评估 6 个月以上远期疗效，焦虑结果未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: Long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed, and anxiety outcomes did not show significant improvement.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summary: Physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district report significant barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders, including inadequate training and resources, leading to infrequent patient care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 地区的物理治疗师在处理盆底疾病（PFD）时面临的严重障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅。这意味着该地区患者很少能得到有效的 PFD 管理，凸显了资源和培训的迫切需求。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底障碍的经验
items.titleEn: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 区的物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFDs）方面面临重大障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅，导致患者管理频率低下。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district face significant barriers in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs), including limited undergraduate training, understaffing, and poor referral pathways, resulting in infrequent patient management.
items.limitation: 研究集中于南非特定地区，限制了其推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on a specific district in South Africa, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on physiotherapy for persistent pelvic pain, outlining key principles and diverse interventions tailored to individual patient needs and pain mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理提供了最新概览，强调了多模式、个体化治疗在不同表型患者中的应用前景。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述综合了当前关于持续性盆腔疼痛物理治疗的证据，概述了根据患者个体需求和疼痛机制量身定制的关键原则和多样化干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review offers an updated overview of physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain, highlighting the potential of multimodal, individualized treatment across different patient phenotypes.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis (27 studies, 1177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) in healthy adults (g = 0.49, p = 0.001), but had smaller, non-significant effects in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065), with higher BMI associated with smaller intervention effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析明确指出，慢性运动训练能改善健康成年人的步行代谢成本，但在卒中患者中效果较小，且肥胖可能削弱这种益处。在为患者制定运动方案时，应考虑这些群体特异性，对卒中患者设置更实际的步行经济性改善预期，并同时关注体重管理。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本影响的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析（27 项研究，1177 名参与者）发现，慢性身体运动训练改善了健康成年人的步行代谢成本（g = 0.40，p = 0.001），其中健康个体效果显著（g = 0.49，p = 0.001），但在卒中患者中效果较小且不显著（g = 0.24，p = 0.065），较高的 BMI 与较小的干预效果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis clearly indicates that chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults, with smaller effects in stroke patients, and obesity may diminish this benefit. When designing exercise programs, consider these population-specific factors, set more realistic expectations for improved walking economy in stroke patients, and simultaneously focus on weight management.
items.limitation: 尽管包含了 27 项研究，但神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小，尤其是多发性硬化和帕金森病患者仅各一项研究，限制了对这些群体结果的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Despite including 27 studies, the sample size for neurological conditions was relatively small, with only one study each for multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease, limiting the certainty of results for these groups.

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: A prospective study of 111 first-ever stroke patients found that physical and psychosocial HRQoL showed divergent recovery trajectories over 3 months. Functional ambulation (β = 0.483, p < 0.001) was associated with physical HRQoL, while depressive symptom severity (β = -0.692, p < 0.001) was associated with mental HRQoL.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复中，身体功能（如步态）和抑郁症状对患者生活质量的改善轨迹有不同影响。制定康复计划时，除了关注身体机能，也务必及早识别并干预抑郁情绪，因为它显著影响患者心理层面的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 卒中后生活质量的早期变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对111名首次卒中患者的前瞻性研究发现，卒中后3个月内身体和心理社会层面的生活质量恢复轨迹存在差异。功能性步态（β = 0.483, p < 0.001）与身体生活质量改善相关，而抑郁症状严重程度（β = -0.692, p < 0.001）与心理生活质量改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In early post-stroke rehabilitation, physical function (e.g., ambulation) and depressive symptoms impact quality of life (HRQoL) improvement differently. When planning rehabilitation, prioritize early identification and intervention for depression, as it significantly affects mental HRQoL, in addition to physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究随访期仅为3个月，可能无法捕捉长期HRQoL的变化，且样本量较小（n=111）。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 3 months, which may not capture long-term HRQoL changes, and the sample size was relatively small (n=111).

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: This scoping review of 80 RCTs found that continuity of care interventions for stroke most often included only stroke survivors and focused on the transition from acute to home care, often neglecting family-centered approaches and other critical transitions in the care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出，中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预研究，常未能同时纳入两者，且未充分涵盖所有照护过渡阶段。你设计康复方案时，要确保覆盖急性期到居家照护之外的更多过渡，并始终以家庭为中心。
items.titleZh: 针对中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 这项对 80 项随机对照试验的范围综述发现，中风连续性照护干预最常只包括中风幸存者，并侧重于从急性期到居家照护的过渡，常忽略以家庭为中心的方法和照护连续体中其他关键过渡。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers often don't include both, and don't adequately cover all care transitions. When designing rehabilitation plans, ensure broader coverage beyond acute to home care transitions, and always adopt a family-centered approach.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，此研究综合了 RCT 的存在和类型，但未评估干预的具体疗效，也未纳入非随机研究。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study synthesized the existence and types of RCTs but did not evaluate the specific efficacy of interventions and did not include non-randomized studies.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes (cognition, mood, anxiety, fatigue) through three reviews at 1, 3, and 6 months, showing potential to address gaps in UK post-stroke care.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后轻中度认知、情绪、焦虑和疲劳改变的患者提供了监测和自我管理支持，可作为英国卒中社区护理的补充。这提示我们可以关注此类患者的心理变化，并考虑将类似简短干预整合到常规康复路径中，尤其在资源有限的社区环境中。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目的开发：一项复杂干预，旨在匹配护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目是一项旨在通过在 1、3 和 6 个月进行三次评估，监测和支持卒中后心理变化（认知、情绪、焦虑、疲劳）自我管理的简短干预措施，有望弥补英国卒中后护理的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers monitoring and self-management support for post-stroke patients with mild-to-moderate cognitive, mood, anxiety, and fatigue changes, complementing UK stroke community care. This suggests focusing on such psychological changes in patients and integrating similar brief interventions into standard rehabilitation pathways, especially in resource-limited community settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项复杂干预措施的设计和开发报告，尚未进行临床有效性测试，其效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This is a report on the design and development of a complex intervention, with clinical effectiveness testing still planned, so its impact is not yet clear.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that caregiver assessments inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH) after stroke. Most studies only assessed subjective financial strain or a single objective indicator, highlighting a need for multidimensional integration in future instruments.
items.curatedReason: 此范围综述揭示，现有中风照护者评估工具未能充分捕捉财务负担和非医疗健康决定因素。你的评估应整合多维度的财务毒性和 NMDOH 指标，以更全面识别脆弱性，并支持更公平、可持续的康复。
items.titleZh: 中风后财务负担、非医疗健康决定因素与早期照护角色形成：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究的范围综述发现，中风后照护者评估未能一致地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康决定因素（NMDOH）。大多数研究仅评估了主观财务压力或单一客观指标，凸显了未来工具中多维度整合的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals that current stroke caregiver assessments inadequately capture financial burden and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH). Your evaluations should integrate multidimensional financial toxicity and NMDOH measures to better identify vulnerabilities and support equitable, sustainable recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未对纳入研究的证据质量进行严格评估，且仅限于过去十年的出版物。
items.limitationEn: This study is a scoping review, which did not rigorously assess the quality of evidence of included studies and was limited to publications from the last ten years.

items.title: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review debunks the heel-strike fallacy and the universal 180 steps/min cadence belief in running, emphasizing individualized adjustments based on specific goals.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述批驳了跑步中“脚跟着地有害”的误解和“每分钟 180 步是普适步频”的信条，强调跑步姿势和步频应根据个体目标进行调整。这意味着我们不应盲目遵循普遍建议，而应根据患者具体情况和目标来指导跑步训练。
items.titleZh: 后足触地谬误与跑者步频信念：一项叙述性综述
items.titleEn: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review | Sports Medicine - Open | Springer Nature Link
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述挑战了长跑中常见的信念，指出后足触地并非固有危害，180步/分钟并非普遍最优步频，且改变应基于个体目标而非普遍性标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review challenges common beliefs in distance running, stating that rearfoot striking is not inherently harmful, 180 steps/min is not universally optimal cadence, and that changes should be based on individual goals rather than generalized targets.
items.limitation: 本文为叙述性综述，不呈现新的实证数据；建议基于现有文献综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review and does not present new empirical data; recommendations are based on synthesizing existing literature.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review highlights shifts in ACL reconstruction toward quadriceps tendon autografts and lateral augmentation for high-risk knees. It emphasizes that return-to-play decisions should be criteria-based, combining time from surgery, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, given that limb symmetry index may overestimate recovery and psychological readiness independently impacts re-injury risk.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的康复和重返运动评估，已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估。未来 ACLR 患者的重返运动方案，应结合手术时间、功能标准和心理准备度进行综合判断。特别注意患者心理准备度对重返运动和二次损伤风险的独立影响。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、外侧增强、康复和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 本综述重点介绍了前交叉韧带重建术向股四头肌腱自体移植和高危膝关节外侧增强的转变。它强调重返运动的决定应基于标准，结合术后时间、功能标准和心理准备，因为肢体对称指数可能高估恢复程度，且心理准备独立影响再次受伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-ACLR rehabilitation and return-to-play assessment have shifted from fixed timelines to criteria-based evaluation. Future return-to-play protocols for ACLR patients should integrate surgical time, functional criteria, and psychological readiness. Pay particular attention to the independent impact of psychological readiness on return-to-sport and second injury risk.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，信息整合可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏系统的证据评估方法。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, and information synthesis may be subject to selection bias, lacking systematic evidence evaluation methods.

items.title: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summary: This study found dysphagia in frail older adults is linked to decreased physical performance (SPPB) and increased fall risk, highlighting the need for routine swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究发现，虚弱老年人的吞咽困难与身体机能下降（SPPB 评分较低）和跌倒风险增加显著相关。这意味着在老年病护理中，常规进行吞咽评估至关重要，不应忽视吞咽功能对整体健康和安全的影响。
items.titleZh: 吞咽困难与衰弱老年人身体机能及跌倒风险的关联
items.titleEn: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults | BMC Geriatrics | Springer Nature Link
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，衰弱老年人的吞咽困难与其较差的身体机能（SPPB 评分降低）和较高的跌倒风险显著相关，强调了在老年护理中进行吞咽评估的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that dysphagia in frail older adults is significantly associated with poorer physical performance (lower SPPB scores) and increased fall risk, underscoring the importance of swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性研究，样本量相对较小（109 例）。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with a relatively small sample size (109 patients).

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 25 RCTs (n=1,540) found that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise were effective for reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders, with multimodal treatments being most effective. The combination of dry needling and manual therapy appeared to be the most effective approach.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持手法治疗和治疗性运动是颞下颌关节紊乱（TMDs）止痛的有效一线干预。当患者出现 TMDs 相关疼痛时，你应优先考虑这些非侵入性治疗手段，且干针联合手法治疗似乎是最有效的组合。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱患者疼痛方面的疗效：一项网络荟萃分析的系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项随机对照试验（n=1,540）的网络荟萃分析发现，手法治疗和治疗性运动在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱疼痛方面有效，其中多模式治疗最为有效。干针结合手法治疗似乎是最有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports manual therapy and therapeutic exercise as effective first-line interventions for pain reduction in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs). When patients present with TMDs-related pain, you should prioritize these non-invasive treatments, and dry needling combined with manual therapy appears to be the most effective combination.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量存在异质性（PEDro 评分 3-9 分），可能影响荟萃分析的整体证据强度。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality of the included studies was heterogeneous (PEDro scores ranging from 3 to 9), which may affect the overall strength of evidence in the meta-analysis.

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: This podcast explores AI's impact on physical therapy practice and payment, discussing its potential to reduce administrative tasks and improve patient care time.
items.curatedReason: AI 的影响已不限于理论，它正在实实在在地改变物理治疗的实践和支付模式。听完这期，你会明白 AI 如何减轻行政负担、优化工作流程，并最终让你有更多时间投入到患者护理中，这才是真正的价值所在。
items.titleZh: 探索人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响
items.titleEn: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment | APTA
items.summaryZh: 这期播客探讨了人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响，重点介绍了其在减轻行政负担、改进工作流程和增加患者护理时间方面的潜力，并汇集了行业领导者的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This podcast episode discusses how AI is impacting physical therapist practice and payment, focusing on reducing administrative burden, improving workflows, and enhancing patient care time, with insights from industry leaders.
items.limitation: 本期播客讨论了应用和误解，而非实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a podcast episode discussing applications and misconceptions, not empirical research.
